PatientBalance.title: PatientBalance
PatientBalance.description:
Computed account balance (charges − payments). Phase 3 cached aggregate.

The first three fields are the original contract; the rest are additive C-3
enrichments and are always present.

SignupRequest.title: SignupRequest
SignupRequest.description:
Self-service registration: provisions a NEW tenant + its admin user.

Deliberately does NOT inject users into an existing tenant (the security gate
flagged in the plan). Joining an existing practice stays invite-only via
``POST /users``.
